text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm☆ The miracle of meeting this child is 
truly marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? The probability of two 
people meeting is said to be one in 
250,000. I wonder if it's the same for a 
person and a plushie?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that! When you factor in the 
odds of Trainer pulling this girl, it's 
just mind-blowing, right? ☆
